title: Build images results
description: Build summary produced by the image build workflows and consumed to dispatch images to state repositories. The registry, repository and image_tag fields compose the published image reference, so they are constrained to the character sets the build workflows can emit. Other fields (flavor, version, image_type, image_repo, build_args, platforms...) are build metadata that legitimately varies, and are therefore left unconstrained.

registry.description: Registry host the image was published to, as produced by the build workflow.

repository.description: Repository path within the registry, including the configured services base path (for example 'service/my-org/my-repo').

image_tag.description: Image tag, as normalized by the build workflow. Slashes are not possible because the build workflow normalizes every other character to a dash.
